outcome: readiness of health facilities for NCD-related services
readiness for chronic respiratory diseases (CRDs) services
readiness for mental, neurological and substance (MNS) use disorders-related services
cohort: The study included data from nationally representative health facilities in Ethiopia.
finding: Overall service readiness for non-communicable diseases (NCDs) remains significantly low across health facilities in Ethiopia, with public and urban facilities demonstrating significantly higher preparedness.
